newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Rio stock exchange ready for Brazil Banerj auction.
newsitem.headline: Rio stock exchange ready for Brazil Banerj auction.

text.p: Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange is ready to carry out the privatization auction of Rio state bank Banerj but the sale still depends on Senate approval of a deal resolving bank's debts, an official said.

Renan Saad, spokesman for the Rio state legal deparment, said the state hopes to hold the auction, previously set for 1400 local/1700 GMT, later Tuesday as the Senate is expected to still vote on the debt deal Tuesday.
He said that as soon as the Senate approves the deal, the auction would take place.
The Senate must give its green light to a 2.9 billion reais loan from federal mortgage bank Caixa Economica Federal (CEF) to cover all of Banerj's pension and payroll-related debts.
Earlier Rio de Janeiro state succeeded in having a court injunction blocking the selloff overturned.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom 5521 50741451))
